description.zh: 自定义属性描述，长度小于256个字符
description.en: The description of the custom attribute. The description must be less than 256 characters in length.

description.zh: 是否在详情页展示，默认为true
description.en: Specifies whether to display the attribute on the product page. The default value is true.

description.zh: 自定义属性展示名称，长度小于128个字符
description.en: The display name of the custom attribute. The name must be less than 128 characters in length.

description.zh:
适用实体类型列表，支持精确实体类型以及 `*-table`、`*-column` 通配写法，如
- dataworks-project 工作空间
- dataworks-dataset dataworks数据集
- maxcompute-table maxcompute表
- *-column 所有字段类型
description.en:
The list of applicable entity types. You can specify precise entity types or use wildcards such as `*-table` and `*-column`. Examples:

- dataworks-project: a DataWorks workspace.

- dataworks-dataset: a DataWorks dataset.

- maxcompute-table: a MaxCompute table.

- \*-column: all field types.

description.zh: 自定义属性ID，需匹配 `^custom-attribute:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,98}$`，custom-attribute: 后面的部分长度小于100
description.en: The ID of the custom attribute. The ID must match the regular expression `^custom-attribute:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,98}$`. The part after \`custom-attribute:\` must be less than 100 characters in length.

description.zh: 是否支持在数据地图搜索页作为筛选条件，默认为false，目前仅ENUM类型配置该值为true
description.en: Specifies whether the attribute can be used as a filter on the Data Map search page. The default value is false. Currently, you can set this parameter to true only for attributes of the ENUM type.

description.zh: 自定义属性类型，支持 ENUM、TEXT、HYPERLINK
description.en: The type of the custom attribute. Valid values are ENUM, TEXT, and HYPERLINK.

description.zh: 枚举可选值，type=ENUM时必填；TEXT、HYPERLINK类型不支持
description.en: The enumeration values. This parameter is required when \`Type\` is set to \`ENUM\`. It is not supported for the TEXT and HYPERLINK types.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public create-custom-attribute --id custom-attribute:biz_owner --display-name '业务负责人' --type TEXT --entity-types maxcompute-table --value-enums VALUE_1 --display-enabled true --search-filter-enabled false --comment test_comment --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public CreateCustomAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --EntityTypes 'maxcompute-table' --Comment test_comment --Type TEXT --SearchFilterEnabled false --DisplayName '业务负责人' --ValueEnums VALUE_1 --Id 'custom-attribute:biz_owner' --DisplayEnabled true
